claims.claim: The California Housing dataset contains 20,640 census-block-group observations and target values derived from the 1990 California census.
claims.notes: This is historical data, not a current housing-price feed; first fetch may require network access.

claims.claim: GroupShuffleSplit separates samples by group labels so a group does not occur in both sides of a split.
claims.notes: A geographic group split tests transfer across groups, not future-time generalization.

claims.claim: Cross-validation evaluates candidate procedures across training/validation folds and must match the deployment sampling assumptions.
claims.notes: Random folds can be inappropriate for time-ordered or grouped observations.

claims.claim: A baseline provides a reference score against which more complex estimators can be evaluated.
claims.locator: scikit-learn model evaluation: dummy estimators and baseline interpretation
claims.notes: A baseline does not establish that a model is useful in the target business process.
